def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ----- Sets -----------------------------------------------------------
    m.L = pyo.Set(initialize=d["lines"], ordered=True)
    m.OD = pyo.Set(initialize=d["od_pairs"], ordered=True)
    m.S = pyo.Set(initialize=d["stations"], ordered=True)

    # Allowed (line, OD) pairs
    allowed = [(i, k) for i in d["lines"] for k in d["line_od"][i]]
    m.LO = pyo.Set(initialize=allowed, dimen=2, ordered=True)

    # ----- Variables ------------------------------------------------------
    # y[i]: line i established (binary)
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.L, within=pyo.Binary)

    # f[i]: trips per hour on line i (integer 0..freq_max)
    m.f = pyo.Var(m.L, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers,
                  bounds=(0, d["freq_max"]))

    # unsat[k]: unsatisfied passengers on OD pair k
    m.unsat = pyo.Var(m.OD, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # z[s]: station s designated as transfer point (binary)
    m.z = pyo.Var(m.S, within=pyo.Binary)

    # serves[i,k]: line i serves OD pair k (binary) -- only for allowed pairs
    m.serves = pyo.Var(m.LO, within=pyo.Binary)

    # ----- Objective: minimize total cost (fixed + operational + penalty) --
    def obj_rule(model):
        fixed = sum(d["fixed_cost"][i] * model.y[i] for i in model.L)
        oper = sum(d["op_cost"][i] * model.f[i] for i in model.L)
        pen = sum(d["penalty"][k] * model.unsat[k] for k in model.OD)
        return fixed + oper + pen
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # ----- Constraints ----------------------------------------------------
    # (a) Frequency bounds when selected: 2*y[i] <= f[i] <= 10*y[i]
    def freq_lb_rule(model, i):
        return model.f[i] >= d["freq_min"] * model.y[i]
    m.freq_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.L, rule=freq_lb_rule)

    def freq_ub_rule(model, i):
        return model.f[i] <= d["freq_max"] * model.y[i]
    m.freq_ub = pyo.Constraint(m.L, rule=freq_ub_rule)

    # (b) Serving linking: serves[i,k] <= y[i]
    def serve_link_rule(model, i, k):
        return model.serves[i, k] <= model.y[i]
    m.serve_link = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=serve_link_rule)

    # (c) Demand coverage: capacity from serving lines + unsat >= demand
    #     Linearised: capacity_per_trip * f[i] * serves[i,k] is bilinear.
    #     Introduce cap[i,k] = capacity_per_trip * f[i] when serves[i,k]=1.
    #     Use big-M: cap[i,k] <= capacity_per_trip * f[i]
    #                cap[i,k] <= big_m * serves[i,k]
    #                cap[i,k] >= capacity_per_trip * f[i] - big_m*(1-serves[i,k])
    m.cap = pyo.Var(m.LO, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def cap_ub1_rule(model, i, k):
        return model.cap[i, k] <= d["capacity_per_trip"] * model.f[i]
    m.cap_ub1 = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=cap_ub1_rule)

    def cap_ub2_rule(model, i, k):
        return model.cap[i, k] <= d["big_m"] * model.serves[i, k]
    m.cap_ub2 = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=cap_ub2_rule)

    def cap_lb_rule(model, i, k):
        return (model.cap[i, k] >= d["capacity_per_trip"] * model.f[i]
                - d["big_m"] * (1 - model.serves[i, k]))
    m.cap_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=cap_lb_rule)

    def demand_rule(model, k):
        capacity = sum(
            model.cap[i, k]
            for i in d["lines"] if k in d["line_od"][i]
        )
        return capacity + model.unsat[k] >= d["demand"][k]
    m.demand = pyo.Constraint(m.OD, rule=demand_rule)

    # (d) Minimum total frequency of lines serving each OD pair
    #     Linearised: freq_served[i,k] = f[i] when serves[i,k]=1.
    m.freq_served = pyo.Var(m.LO, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def fs_ub1_rule(model, i, k):
        return model.freq_served[i, k] <= model.f[i]
    m.fs_ub1 = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=fs_ub1_rule)

    def fs_ub2_rule(model, i, k):
        return model.freq_served[i, k] <= d["big_m"] * model.serves[i, k]
    m.fs_ub2 = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=fs_ub2_rule)

    def fs_lb_rule(model, i, k):
        return (model.freq_served[i, k] >= model.f[i]
                - d["big_m"] * (1 - model.serves[i, k]))
    m.fs_lb = pyo.Constraint(m.LO, rule=fs_lb_rule)

    def min_freq_rule(model, k):
        total_freq = sum(
            model.freq_served[i, k]
            for i in d["lines"] if k in d["line_od"][i]
        )
        return total_freq >= d["min_od_frequency"]
    m.min_freq = pyo.Constraint(m.OD, rule=min_freq_rule)

    # (e) Vehicle limit: total frequency <= max_vehicles
    def vehicle_rule(model):
        return sum(model.f[i] for i in model.L) <= d["max_vehicles"]
    m.vehicle = pyo.Constraint(rule=vehicle_rule)

    # (f) Transfer point: z[s] = 1 only if at least 2 lines pass through s.
    def transfer_rule(model, s):
        lines_at_s = [i for i in d["lines"] if s in d["line_stations"][i]]
        if not lines_at_s:
            return model.z[s] == 0
        return sum(model.y[i] for i in lines_at_s) >= 2 * model.z[s]
    m.transfer = pyo.Constraint(m.S, rule=transfer_rule)

    return m

        return fixed + op + pen
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)
